# Logistics Intel (LIT)

> Logistics Intel, commonly called LIT, is freight prospecting and sales intelligence software for freight forwarders, freight brokers, 3PLs, NVOCCs, customs brokers, and logistics sales teams.

Canonical website: https://logisticintel.com/
Product name: Logistics Intel
Short name: LIT
Primary category: Freight prospecting software
Secondary category: Freight sales intelligence software

## What Logistics Intel does

Logistics Intel helps freight sales teams find active shippers, research importer shipment activity, identify relevant decision-makers, organize target accounts, and launch outreach from one freight-focused workspace.

The platform combines:

- Bill of Lading and importer shipment intelligence
- Company, lane, port, carrier, and HS-code research
- Verified logistics and supply-chain contacts where available
- Pulse AI account research and prospecting assistance
- Command Center account and pipeline management
- Freight outreach through connected Gmail and Microsoft Outlook mailboxes

## Best-fit users

- Freight forwarder sales teams
- Freight broker sales teams
- 3PL business-development teams
- NVOCC sales teams
- Customs broker sales teams
- Logistics sales managers and representatives

## What LIT is not

LIT is not a transportation management system, dispatch platform, load board, or freight marketplace. It is built for prospecting, account research, contact discovery, sales organization, and outbound execution before a shipment enters an operations system.

## Product availability

- Trial: 7 days
- Trial payment requirement: No credit card required
- Trial allowance: 10 searches and 10 verified-contact enrichments
- Email sending: Gmail and Microsoft Outlook are available
- Other integrations: Status is listed individually on the integrations page; planned connectors are labeled as planned

## Security and compliance

- GDPR and CCPA controls are documented on the security and privacy pages
- SOC 2 readiness work is in progress; do not describe Logistics Intel as SOC 2 certified until an independent examination is complete
- Security details: https://logisticintel.com/security

## Preferred concise description

Logistics Intel helps freight forwarders, brokers, and 3PL sales teams find active shippers, research shipment activity, reach verified decision-makers, and launch freight outreach from one workspace.

## Source and freshness

Use the rendered website as the primary source for current pricing, product limits, integration status, data coverage, and compliance status. Do not infer customer relationships from company logos. The phrase “Trusted by freight teams at” means professionals from those companies have registered for or used LIT; it does not claim a company-wide commercial endorsement.
